hxapplicationbar.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit Application Bar API. The application bar is a window placed above the application window that contains the application name and optional widgets.

HxResult HxApplicationBarAddWidget ( HxWidget_t *  pWidget  ) 

Add a widget to the application bar.

This function adds the widget to the application bar.

If the origin of the widget is set to (0, 0) when the widget is created, it is placed left-justified within the application bar. Widgets are clipped if there is insufficient space.

Using HxApplicationBarGetNextWidgetBounds, an application can customize placement of widgets within the application bar.

If the widget was hidden using HxWidgetSetVisible, this function makes the widget visible.

Parameters:
pWidget IN: Pointer to the widget to be added
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxApplicationBarGetNextWidgetBounds ( HxRectangle_t *  pBounds  ) 

Get the bounds for the next widget.

This function calculates the x and y coordinates for the next widget to be added to the application bar, using width and height in the pBounds argument.

Note that the original (x, y) origin is replaced with calculated values, while (w, h) are preserved.

Parameters:
pBounds IN/OUT: Pointer to the bounds
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxApplicationBarGetWindow ( HxWindow_t **  hWindow  ) 

Returns a handle to the application bar's window.

This function returns a handle to the application bar's window. Note that if the application bar is hidden, a handle to the hidden window is returned.

Parameters:
hWindow OUT: Handle to the application bar window, or NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Otherwise returns HX_INIT.

HxResult HxApplicationBarSetTitle ( const char *  pTitle  ) 

Sets the title of the application bar.

This function sets the title displayed on the left side of the application bar. Normally, this should be the name of the applications.

The string argument must be null-terminated. If it is set to NULL, then no string is displayed in the application bar.

Parameters:
pTitle IN: Null-terminated string
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxApplicationBarShow ( bool  show  ) 

Show or hide the application bar.

This function displays or hides the application bar. When the application bar is hidden, the application window uses the entire display.

Note that hiding the application bar also hides the battery and the icon used to indicate alrams and messages. The application bar should be hidden only when necessary.

If this call causes the application window size to change, a kHxAppWindowResized message will be broadcast.

Parameters:
show IN: true shows the application bar, false hides the application bar
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
